svg.aria-label: Zephyr firmware block diagram for one Teensy 4.1 leg controller: five threads, INA228 current sensing
svg.text: Per-leg firmware on Teensy 4.1 — threads, data flow, checks

g.text: Ethernet switch · Zephyr net stack + ENET driver (RX/TX at ISR level) · UDP
armed? I > limit? ALRT pin? current fresh?
trip → leg PWM off + latch · range → clamp
servos now: direct · motors later: PID

svg.text: health flag (set every tick, read by supervisor)
in telemetry yet: protocol change on both sides

g.text: resets MCU if not fed in time
outputs off → HAL init (INA228 check + alert limits, ALRT pins)

svg.text: shared object (short locked copy, queue or atomics)
loss/CRC counters: atomics — RX writes, TX + supervisor read
magic = fixed start marker (0xC0DE); non-matching packets dropped
sender uptime jumps back = restart → sequence tracking resets
ENABLE: arms at measured pose, refused if faults latched; CLEAR_FAULTS only while disarmed
fault bits: 0x01 over-current · 0x02 range · 0x04 comms lost · 0x08 I²t · 0x10 tracking ·
0x20 stack · 0x40 current stale (> 20 ms) · 0x80 ALRT pin (INA228's own limit)
the current thread is the only one on I²C; the control thread never waits for the bus
Thread 1 — Control (1 kHz, prio 2): the "Control thread" container:
- read sensors: 3× position (ADC), 3× current (current slot), 3× ALRT pin (GPIO)
- copy setpoints from slot / drain command queue (ENABLE also asks to zero energy)
- comms fresh? heartbeat < 500 ms, else failsafe / disarm · setpoint < 50 ms, else hold
- per-tick checks (armed? I > limit? ALRT pin? current fresh? pos in range?)
Thread 2 — Current (1 kHz, prio 3): the "Current thread" container, the only thread on I²C:
- read 3× current from the INA228s → current slot (stale after 20 ms → control disarms)
- ALRT fault latched? read that board's DIAG_ALRT (logs which limit, releases the pin)
- 10 Hz, one board per tick: VBUS · power · energy · charge → supply slot
- 10 Hz: read the setup back; set it up again if the board lost power
- a board that answers again is checked at once
Thread 3 — Net RX (prio 5): the "Net RX thread" container:
- recvfrom() blocks on UDP :5005 (master IP only)
- magic + CRC ok? (else CRC err++) · leg ID ours?
- setpoints → slot / commands → k_msgq / heartbeat → t_hBeat
Thread 4 — Telemetry TX (500 Hz, prio 7): the "Telemetry TX" container:
Thread 5 — Supervisor (10–50 Hz, prio 9): the "Supervisor" container:
- slow checks (I²t, tracking error, stack margins; loss only logged)
- on fault: flag in telemetry, disable leg
- health flag fresh? feed WDOG / don't feed → HW reset
